messages:
tara: FYI inbound from NebulaPay (payments platform). They want a POC compliance bundle for procurement: redacted SOC2 control mappings, signed pen-test attestation (not full report), network/data flow for our on-prem connector, SSO/SAML metadata sample, staging IP allowlist, and confirmation of model version support + EOL. Also asked if Dedicated changes latency SLA or adds setup lead time.

noah: I can pull SOC2 controls + sample evidence snippets. Quick ask: do we include control test dates or just the control narrative? Procurement usually prefers dates.

claire: We should include test dates for transparency but redact tester PII and raw vuln outputs. Attestation can be a 1-page letter signed by Head of Security. We already have a standard attestation template — I'll adapt.

ops: For on-prem connector diagram I can produce a sequence/data-flow diagram and a short checklist for firewall rules. Staging IPs: 52.210.0.0/20, 52.211.16.0/20, plus our egress NAT pool. If they want fixed origin IPs for the POC we can provide elastic NATs (adds infra change + cost).

noah: Good. For model EOL: we currently serve model v1.3.2 for the hosted stack; EOL policy: major versions supported for 12 months after release, security patches for 18 months. I'll include a one-line note.

claire: Draft attestation text below. I'll sign once @security-bot triggers approval.

claire: ```
Penetration Test Attestation
Date: <DATE>
To: <Customer Legal Name>
Redwood Inference confirms that a third-party penetration test covering the production inference endpoints and orchestration layer was performed. The vendor test scope did not include customer-supplied datasets. No critical vulnerabilities impacting confidentiality or integrity were present in the assessed scope at time of testing. This attestation is not a substitute for the full penetration test report.
Signed,
Claire Barnes (Head of Security)
```

tara: Two timeline notes: Nebula wants everything by Wednesday COB to keep onboarding in Q2. Also legal asked that we don't include any raw scan logs or IP addresses of our test vendors in the bundle.

ops: Working plan: (1) noah - assemble SOC2-redacted.pdf with test dates + control mappings; (2) ops - network-diagram.pdf + staging-ips.txt; (3) claire - attestation.pdf & sign; (4) tara - confirm Dedicated pricing delta and SLA note in the quote addendum.

security-bot: Automated check: attestation template passes policy. Please run manual review for legal language if you add indemnity phrasing.

noah: Assembled package and uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/nebulapay-poc-3333/package_draft.zip (presigned link shared). Contents: SOC2-controls-redacted.pdf, attestation-draft.pdf, connector-diagram.pdf, staging-ips.txt, saml-metadata-example.xml, pricing-delta.pdf.

claire: Reviewing attestation now. If all good I'll sign and re-upload signed_attestation.pdf.

ops: Note on Dedicated: setup lead is typically 10 business days for allocation + network prep; pricing delta shown in addendum is $6,000 one-time setup + $8k/month commit for the POC. I'll mark it optional. This does not change baseline latency SLA; Dedicated customers can request stricter SLOs at additional cost.

tara: Perfect. I'll communicate timeline and the optional Dedicated add-on to procurement. Thanks everyone :rocket:

noah: Uploaded signed_attestation.pdf to same S3 path and updated package_v2.zip. Presigned link expires in 5 days. Will update once Nebula confirms receipt.
